svg.title: The Darkwave Agent Mesh: one install on a Kubernetes cluster
svg.desc: Outside a Kubernetes cluster: the Operator, who calls the control API through the command line, and the cloud AI models and external systems, reached through ports and adapters. Inside: the control plane and the Agent pods, one per Agent, which the Agent Mesh provides; a model server, NATS JetStream (the bus stream, and the record and exceptions buckets) and the definitions, which the install supplies. The control plane and the Agent pods use NATS and read the definitions. Arrows show who calls whom.
